rules.title: Required tenant-rights form with notice to quit for nonpayment of rent
rules.requirement: A landlord's written notice to quit a residential tenant for nonpayment of rent must include a state form with any repayment agreements, information on rental assistance, court rules, and legal restrictions on eviction, plus a statement that the notice is not an eviction. Courts may not accept a nonpayment eviction filing without proof that the form was delivered.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential tenants receiving a written notice to quit for nonpayment of rent from a landlord in Massachusetts. Applies to summary process actions for nonpayment of rent for residential dwelling units, including in the Boston municipal court department.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to notices to quit for nonpayment of rent

rules.penalty: Court may not accept for filing a writ, summons or complaint in a nonpayment eviction without proof of delivery of the form.
rules.quoted_span: No court having jurisdiction over an action for summary process pursuant to chapter 239, including the Boston municipal court department, shall, in an eviction for nonpayment of rent for a residential dwelling unit, accept for filing a writ, summons or complaint without proof of delivery of the form required under this section.
rules.conflict_note: This is a procedural notice requirement for nonpayment evictions, not a substantive just-cause requirement; it was classified under just_cause_eviction as the closest category. The document does not state an effective date.
